name: animehub
description: AnimeHub — a launcher for anime sites with encrypted session storage and platform-specific session handling.

scripts.build: tauri icon src-tauri/icon.svg --output src-tauri/icons && vite build
scripts.test: node --test tests/bridge.test.js tests/gaps.test.js tests/security.test.js tests/tiles.test.js tests/theme.test.js tests/theme_flow.test.js tests/hero.test.js tests/pip_controller.test.js tests/init_script.test.js tests/focus.test.js tests/settings_flow.test.js tests/android_isolation.test.js tests/back_close.test.js tests/storage_scope.test.js tests/hidden_sites.test.js tests/command_wiring.test.js tests/debug_log.test.js tests/copy_text.test.js tests/desktop_proxy_wiring.test.js
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run test:rust
